records.title: On Combining XAI and LLMs for Trustworthy Zero-Touch Network and Service Management in 6G
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://doi.org/10.1109/MCOM.002.2400276. Primary abstract applies XAI and LLMs to 6G service management; it does not optimize LLM inference/serving.

records.title: VideoLLaMB: Long-context Video Understanding with Recurrent Memory Bridges
records.reason: Efficiency evidence is confined to a specialized video LVLM architecture and visual-context workload.

records.title: Preparing for Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) in Health Professions Education: AMEE Guide No. 172
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://doi.org/10.1080/0142159X.2024.2387802. Primary abstract is an education guide on AGI in health-professions education, outside scope.

records.title: Pruning Large Language Models with Semi-Structural Adaptive Sparse Training
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.20584. Primary abstract proposes adaptive sparse training/pruning for LLMs; its method is training-oriented rather than inference-time or serving optimization.

records.title: E.T.: Re-Thinking Self-Attention for Transformer Models on GPUs
records.reason: The abstract suggests GPU attention acceleration for BERT-family models, but without primary full text the mechanism, evaluation, and applicability cannot be confirmed.
